FIX IT FAST! ↗Computer Rescue • Hardware / Memory / Storage
Teacher notes & photo credits

Allow 15–20 minutes. Students may discuss in pairs or small groups; enter all names for a shared report. Five cases are drawn from ten, with one case per topic. All prices are fictional classroom prices; stated upgrades are compatible. No purchases, accounts, or internet access are needed.

Scoring: 3 points for a first-choice solution, 2 on the retry, 0 after two incorrect choices. Each independently solved case also earns 1 budget point if its fix fits the remaining budget (maximum 5). After two misses, a guided repair is applied without earning points. Correct repairs total $330–$390 per session, within the $500 starting budget. Unconfirmed or incorrect choices never cost money.

This is a practice activity, not a secure testing platform. Reports are downloaded locally; students must submit them themselves. Refreshing resumes this tab when browser session storage is available. Closing the tab may erase progress.
